description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the model size parameter M (ranging from 3 to 8 on a linear scale) and the perplexity score (ranging from approximately 15 to 42 on a linear scale) for three different configurations: LLaMA1-7B (green line with circle markers), an orange line with star markers, and a blue line with triangle markers. The green line representing LLaMA1-7B starts at a perplexity of ~28 at M=3, dips slightly to ~24 at M=5, then rises gradually to ~36 at M=8. The orange line begins at ~20 at M=3, decreases to a minimum of ~16 at M=5, then slowly increases to ~20 at M=8. The blue line starts at ~41 at M=3, declines to ~34 at M=5, remains relatively flat until M=7, then rises sharply to ~40 at M=8. All three lines show non-monotonic behavior, with the blue line exhibiting the highest perplexity across most M values and the orange line consistently showing the lowest.
